core_operational_intents.name: Delivery_Tracking_And_Delays
core_operational_intents.description: Customer inquiring about shipment status, package tracking updates, or delayed 1-day/2-day Prime delivery.
core_operational_intents.typical_resolution: Amazon agent provides carrier tracking link, explains Prime dispatch vs delivery SLAs, or advises waiting 24h for carrier scan.
examples: @AmazonHelp I ordered an item on Tuesday with next day delivery, but it's still not arrived, help??
Real fucking talk @AmazonHelp ur shit! Prime shipping my ass!!! Where is my damn moisturizer tik tok
What happens when you pay for guaranteed delivery with @AmazonHelp but you don't get your parcel on time?
non_examples: Order shows delivered but stolen from porch (belongs to Marked_Delivered_Not_Received)
Want to cancel my late order (belongs to Order_Cancellation_And_Address_Change)

core_operational_intents.name: Technical_App_And_Website_Issues
core_operational_intents.description: Customer reporting website bugs, Amazon app crashes, checkout button grayed out, cart error codes, or browser payment gateway glitches.
core_operational_intents.typical_resolution: Amazon agent provides app cache clearing instructions, browser cookie reset steps, or escalates tech bug to Web Engineering team.
examples: Checkout button is greyed out on Amazon app!
Is your website down? Keep getting error code 500 when trying to pay.
Amazon app keeps crashing every time I open my shopping cart.
non_examples: Cannot stream Prime Video movie (belongs to Prime_Subscription_And_Digital_Media)

core_operational_intents.name: Prime_Subscription_And_Digital_Media
core_operational_intents.description: Customer reporting Prime Video streaming bugs, Kindle ebook sync failures, FireTV issues, or Prime membership billing.
core_operational_intents.typical_resolution: Amazon agent provides step-by-step device deregistration/re-registration steps, app cache clearing, or checks regional licensing rights.
examples: There should be far more films for #noirvember on Amazon Prime and Netflix in India than there are.
My Amazon Echo hasn't been playing Spotify for three days upon request. What's going on @AmazonHelp?
Why am I getting charged $12.99 for Prime when I cancelled my trial last week?
non_examples: Physical Prime package not delivered (belongs to Delivery_Tracking_And_Delays)

core_operational_intents.name: Refund_Status_And_Billing_Disputes
core_operational_intents.description: Customer inquiring about pending refund status, double credit card charges, unauthorized transactions, or refund voucher credits.
core_operational_intents.typical_resolution: Amazon agent explains bank refund processing timelines (3-5 business days) or directs customer to secure billing page to verify charges.
examples: @AmazonHelp not refunding my ₹26,000! Product was never delivered as seller closed account!
I was charged twice on my credit card for order #404-8406898. Please check!
When will my refund reflect in my bank account? It shows refunded 4 days ago.
non_examples: How much is Prime monthly subscription? (belongs to Prime_Subscription_And_Digital_Media)

core_operational_intents.name: Return_Exchange_And_Pickup
core_operational_intents.description: Customer requesting product return, item exchange, reverse pickup label, or reporting courier pickup no-show.
core_operational_intents.typical_resolution: Amazon agent provides link to Online Returns Center, reschedules reverse pickup window, or issues instant promotional refund credit.
examples: Reverse orders are picked up and show as pickup cancelled! Call customer service - they say product not received!
How do I print a return label if I don't have a printer?
Courier was supposed to pick up my return parcel yesterday between 9am-5pm but nobody turned up.
non_examples: Cancel my order before it ships (belongs to Order_Cancellation_And_Address_Change)

core_operational_intents.name: Order_Cancellation_And_Address_Change
core_operational_intents.description: Customer requesting order cancellation, pre-dispatch modification, or updating shipping address post-purchase.
core_operational_intents.typical_resolution: Amazon agent explains pre-dispatch cancellation rules, confirms cancellation status, or guides user to 'Your Orders' tab.
examples: @AmazonHelp My order (Philips Toothbrush) has a better price available, £5 cheaper. Can I cancel my order and re-order?
I accidentally put my old home address on my order! Can I change it before it ships?
Please cancel order #407-2566173 immediately, ordered by mistake.
non_examples: I want to return a product I already received (belongs to Return_Exchange_And_Pickup)

core_operational_intents.name: Damaged_Defective_Or_Wrong_Item
core_operational_intents.description: Customer received a physically broken product, defective hardware, incorrect item variant, missing accessory, or tampered package.
core_operational_intents.typical_resolution: Amazon agent apologizes for condition, offers immediate free replacement dispatch, or generates pre-paid return mailing label.
examples: Ordered a phone case, look what I got 😂 @AmazonHelp what's happening?
@AmazonHelp Are you guys desperate to get rid of this Bjork album? This is the second time! I need the right vinyl!
Kinda sucks when you package is all jacked up when you get it. Thanks @AmazonHelp
non_examples: Package arrived 3 days late (belongs to Delivery_Tracking_And_Delays)

core_operational_intents.name: General_Service_Complaint_Escalation
core_operational_intents.description: Customer expressing severe frustration with past customer service, long phone hold times, or demanding supervisor escalation.
core_operational_intents.typical_resolution: Amazon agent apologizes for past agent experience and provides dedicated callback link.
examples: @AmazonHelp your customer service SUCKS!!! Every time I try to make an order I have an issue!
I frankly don't have the patience for another chat with your customer service people today.
Hopeless amazon and their customer service too. Never trust this website.
non_examples: My order is 1 day late (belongs to Delivery_Tracking_And_Delays)

core_operational_intents.name: Promotions_GiftCards_And_Pricing
core_operational_intents.description: Customer inquiring about promo codes, gift card balance redemption errors, Lightning Deal discounts, or invoice requests.
core_operational_intents.typical_resolution: Amazon agent verifies promo T&Cs, provides manual voucher credit, or guides customer to 'Your Account -> Gift Cards'.
examples: @AmazonHelp my gift card balance of $50 is not applying at checkout!
Why did the price drop £5 right after I purchased my order?
I need a tax invoice receipt for my order last month. Where can I download it?
non_examples: Double charge on credit card (belongs to Refund_Status_And_Billing_Disputes)

core_operational_intents.name: Marked_Delivered_Not_Received
core_operational_intents.description: Customer states tracking status shows 'Delivered', but package was never received (stolen, misdelivered, or false carrier scan).
core_operational_intents.typical_resolution: Amazon agent warns against posting Order ID publicly, asks customer to check with household/neighbors, and directs customer to secure callback link.
examples: @AmazonHelp my account says my same day delivery order was delivered yesterday but I never received my package.
With out delivering it is showing as 'Delivered' ....want to see receive copy.... @AmazonHelp
Pinche @AmazonHelp for delivering the parcel to the wrong apartment. Congrats to my neighbor who got a free copy!
non_examples: Package has not shipped yet (belongs to Delivery_Tracking_And_Delays)

auxiliary_triage_pre_filter.name: Non_English_Or_Regional_Query
auxiliary_triage_pre_filter.description: Non-English queries (Spanish, German, Japanese, Portuguese) routed directly to regional handles (@AmazonHelpES, @AmazonHelpDE).

unclassified_noise_pool.name: Other_Unclassified_Inquiry
unclassified_noise_pool.description: General conversational banter, link-only posts, vague tweets, or unactionable chatter.
